mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, the strengthening labor market indicates a robust economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 30% of triggered instances, or the joint proxy correlation coefficient falls below 0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, signaling improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 45% of non-recession quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, indicating a strong housing market, boosts overall economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 35% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 6-month average increase of 2.5%, signaling rising inflation, investors anticipate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds the 2.5% threshold, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when PAYEMS shows a 2-month consecutive decrease and UNRATE rises above 5.5%, the weakening labor market indicates economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 25% of triggered instances, or the joint proxy correlation coefficient falls below 0.35 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, signaling rising retail sales, enhances overall economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of holiday seasons with positive RSAFS growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.
